title.narrative: Enhancing Resilience Through an Integrated Livelihoods and Education Response in Aleppo and Lattakia Governorates

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project’s aim is to provide livelihoods opportunities and enhancement of quality education for families in Aleppo (As-Safira City and Tal Hassel Town) and Lattakia (Talla) Governorates. The project will facilitate children’s access to education and provide immediate income-generating opportunities for families. In the long term, the focus shifts to enrolling OOSC in education, tackling family income barriers, and helping community resilience through income-generating initiatives. This is designed to break the cycle of vulnerability and create a foundation for sustained wellbeing of beneficiaries, bearing in mind as well the unique needs of new returnees.ltbrgtEDU: Improving and increasing the quality of education in the targeted areas, which will be done through training teachers, enhancing school infrastructure, and ensuring access to learning materials. The project will also establish catch-up programs for children who dropped out of school paying attention to displaced or newly returnees, who have no or very limited educational backgrounds, which can help bridge educational gaps and not just reintegrate children into formal education, but also boost the children’s well-being and widen the social network. ltbrgt- Identification of OOSC, through BTL campaigns, placing priority in targeting households with out-of-school children serviced by other sectors (ensuring integrated programming): 350 children reached from BTL campaigns. ltbrgt- NFE provision targeted at integration into formal system at grade-level: Curricula B/Accelerated Learning Programs, Self-Learning Program, or any other form of non-formal education provision for OOSC: 350 children supported to enroll in non-formal education (all categories). ltbrgt- Provision of school supplies targeting non-formal learners, including school materials, bags, and textbooks: 350 children receiving school supplies. ltbrgt- Crossline / cross-border response: 700 children assisted with crossline exams through hygiene and dignity kits. ltbrgt- Rehabilitation/establishment of classrooms. Rehabilitation may include re-equipment, WASH, access for CWD and solar panels to enable schools to operate in multiple shifts: 37 classrooms benefiting from inclusive repair, or rehabilitation 4 WaSH blocks benefitting from gender-sensitive and disability-sensitive WASH facilities 4 schools or learning spaces provided with furniture (desks, chairs, blackboards, etc.) 4 schools/ learning spaces provided with solar power systems. ltbrgt- Teacher Professional Development, including MHPSS training to reinforce student well-being and domains supportive of the delivery of quality, protective education: 30 teachers and education personnel trained 1600 children benefiting from school-based MHPSS support 30 teachers and education personnel benefiting from school-based MHPSS support ltbrgt- Provision of materials to support the delivery of education, including pedagogical materials: 30 teachers and education personnel receiving teaching resources, kits and guides ltbrgt- Provision of remedial education supporting retention of children at risk of dropping out: 900 children supported to retain in non-formal education by Remedial Classes. ltbrgt- Provision of school supplies targeting formal learners, including school materials, bags, and textbooks: 1250 children receiving school supplies ltbrgt- Targeted support to establish Parent-Teacher Associations, enabling community engagement in education and protective services: 4 PTAs or parent engagement initiatives supported or established ltbrgtERL: Providing income-generating opportunities for parents and caregivers, including skills workshops and MSME support. A focus will be on sustainable livelihoods like agriculture, handicrafts, or small business, helping families rely less on negative coping mechanisms. ltbrgt- Provision of 85 support grants for existing Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs)ltbrgt- Support 15 people to start (or re-start) a social or business entrepreneurship startupltbrgt- Creation of 40 short-term jobsltbrgtlt/pgt
